about: Each thing's box and labels as Graphviz 16.1.0 (@viz-js/viz 3.31.0) measured them, relative to its box, in CSS pixels. Written on 9 Nov 2026, before Graphviz was removed, so our own measuring is held to it.

cases.source: digraph G { subgraph cluster_a { label="A"; a1; a2; } subgraph cluster_b { label="B"; b1; b2; } c; a1 -> b1; a2 -> c; b2 -> c; }
